snippet.title: WHITE ALBUM 2 - Closing Chapter - PV
snippet.description:
White Album 2 Closing Chapter PV Translation:

Sugiura Koharu – "Senpai, you're so strange. You’re strict, kind, and always take care of others, but somehow, you feel so cold and distant..."
Houjou High School, class 3-A. First term class representative.
Serious, reliable and passionate.
Her personality is very similar to a certain someone's.

Izumi Chiaki – "Well, I'm free most of the time. If you're ever feeling restless, feel free to give me a call, all right?"
Houjou University junior, literature major.
Lazy, a typical lethargic college student.
However, she’s interested in a certain someone...

Things that didn't change 
"S-senpai... I... I..."
Things that changed   
"I'll be any sort of partner you want me to be, Haruki. A good friend of yours, a bad influence on you... Or even... "
As if to cover up everything, the snow falls once again – 
 
Kazaoka Mari – "You've worked so hard on this! What do you mean, no one would be happy about it? How can you say something like that?"
Editor in a magazine publishing company.
Talented, successful, and a workaholic.
Haruki's superior.

Ogiso Setsuna – "Liar... Haruki-kun, you liar. Liar... Liar, liar, LIAR!"
Houjou University junior.
The campus idol.
Relationship status – Unknown.

"There's... no place left for me in this country anymore."

PV of closing chapter that you get at the end of Introductory Chapter. Song is 'Todokanai Koi' by Setsuna Ogiso.
